[Em/C#]later [C7M]

[Em/C#]corner [C7M]

[Em/C#]dry [C7M]
[G]

[Bm7]me see you cryin

[D]

[E7M]  [Cmaj7]
[D]
[Bm7]

[Em/C#]calm down [C7M]

[Em/C#]cool [C7M]
[G]  [G7/D]
[Em/C#]Viceroy, [C7M]
[G]as [G7/D]it's gettin
[Em/C#]later [C7M]
[G7/D][G]Headin' for the
[Em/C#]corner, [C7M]
[G]I'm [G7/D]leavin it to
[Em/C#]you. [C7M]
